authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/dreadbox/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/dreadbox/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the CC list, with its printed name, sent as a control change on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The list: "All the values either numerical or enumerated are split in the whole CC range of 0-127." A range (`0 - 100`) is 0 - 127 shown as printed; a list of settings is a choice, each sent at the middle of its equal share of 0 - 127.

The list: CC 31 (Selector) chooses whether the controllers after it set a parameter's value or one of its modulation amounts (mod wheel, velocity, aftertouch, CC74, key track); for a modulation amount, 0 is -100, 64 is 0 and 127 is +100.
Left out, the wheel, the pedals, bank select and the channel mode messages: CC 0 Bank Select, CC 64 Sustain, CC 120 ALL SOUNDS OFF, CC 123 ALL NOTES OFF.
